Inside, the paper was brown at the edges but dry: “To whoever tends the last light before the drowned reef—my brother swore the bell sank with him, yet I hear it on calm nights, ringing under the foam.” The keeper read it twice, then looked toward the black rocks where gulls were arguing over nothing. Near midnight, faint but certain, a bell answered from below the reef, and every flame in the house leaned toward the sound.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像刚退潮的礁石，露出安静而锋利的边缘。高架桥还亮着橙色的灯，出租车划过空荡的路口，便利店白光里漂着饭团的甜气。清洁车慢慢喷水，把昨夜的烟味、酒气和争吵压进排水沟。远处工地的塔吊停在半空，像忘记落下的手；住宅楼只有零星窗户醒着，或许有人喂奶，有人失眠，有人赶最后一班地铁。天没有立刻亮，只是在楼群背后渗出一点灰蓝，仿佛有人悄悄掀开黑色幕布的一角。此刻的城市不温柔，也不残忍，它只是暂时卸下表情，让孤独公平地落在每一条街。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a thing solves a big problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n- It must keep making the problem smaller, like opening smaller and smaller boxes.\n- It stops when it reaches a tiny case it can answer directly, then passes the answers back up."}
